question: A student proposes using a **standard cyclotron (uniform $\vec{B}$ and fixed RF accelerating frequency)** to accelerate electrons to extremely high energies (near the speed of light). Evaluate the primary physical reason why this proposal will fail.

options.A: The magnetic force on electrons is too weak due to their small charge.
options.B: Electrons rotate in the opposite direction to protons, so they must hit the walls.
options.C: Relativistic mass increase causes the frequency of revolution to decrease, so the electrons fall out of resonance with the fixed RF voltage.
options.D: The small mass of the electron requires an RF oscillator frequency that is too low to generate.
